dispositions.reason: Revisions that landed before, or in the same days as, this repository's move to per-merged-revision dispatch (#847, #857; matrix dispatch landed 2026-09-08). They carry no verdict because no run was ever created for them. Not backfilled: #858 measured that backfilling twenty historical trees against the current estate produced an exact split by validator age, not by tree, so a blanket backfill would record verdicts about the validator rather than about the revision. A revision backfilled deliberately is recorded here by re-measuring through a reviewed pull request; the rolling scheduled audit moving past it records nothing.
dispositions.recorded_by: lotus-platform Cycle 6 seat; evidence on #858 (comment 5651426767) and the steering checkpoint

dispositions.reason: Verdict-bearing runs that failed: intermediate revisions of rebase-merged pull requests, or backfilled trees measured against a newer estate. Retained as recorded history and not rerun; a failing verdict is information beside coverage, not a gap.
